description: Two counters, each sending a 10ms pulse once every so many clocks

params.text: Sets that counter back to zero and holds it there while it is held down
Sets how many clocks pass between that counter's pulses, a whole number from 1 to 32, and is the number that counter's display shows

inputs.text: Steps that counter on each rising edge, reading high above 1V and low at 0V or below
Sets that counter back to zero and holds it there while it stays high, which stops that counter counting

outputs.text: A 10ms pulse each time that counter reaches the number its knob is set to

notes: the display shows the number of clocks the counter divides by, not how far it has counted, and it is drawn rather than built from controls, so it cannot be clicked
